subject: FinOps SIG kickoff, SOC 2 status & clarifying questions
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finops.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0000
Subject: FinOps SIG kickoff, SOC 2 status & clarifying questions

Hi Alex — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying items so we can kick off the SIG/CAIQ process cleanly: 

Recap (from call)
- FinOps confirmed they process customer billing telemetry and some PII tied to invoices.
- Compliance needs: SOC 2 report, HIPAA for certain customers, GDPR data residency in EU for a subset of customers.
- FinOps prefers SIG-Core over custom CAIQ, but open to alternatives depending on scoping.

Requests / clarifiers from Redwood
1) Which questionnaire do you want us to complete: SIG-Core, SIG-Lite, or a FinOps-provided CAIQ-style doc? (We can handle all, just want to scope effort.)
2) SOC 2 status: can you confirm the date of your most recent SOC 2 Type II and whether a bridge letter is available? (We attached our last SOC 2 report for your reference.)
3) HIPAA scope: which specific data flows should be considered HIPAA-covered? (e.g., billing data only, or customer-submitted health info?)
4) EU data residency: do you require Redwood to pin processing to EU regions for all customers or only for specific accounts?

Attachments: Redwood-SIG-Initiation-Pack.zip (includes our standard SIG template and a short checklist), SOC2-Report-2025.pdf

Next steps
- Please reply with which questionnaire you prefer and the SOC 2 date.
- If you want FinOps to share a template, please attach it; we can prefill items and then route for your security review.
- Grace (cc'd) will own the questionnaire at Redwood and can set a 30- or 60-day ETA depending on scope.

Availability: happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff with your security engineer — propose Thu Jun 11 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri Jun 12 08:00-10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

---
Attachment stubs: Redwood-SIG-Initiation-Pack.zip (application/zip), SOC2-Report-2025.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finops.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@finops.co>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 18:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: FinOps SIG kickoff, SOC 2 status & clarifying questions

Hi Monica — thanks for the summary and for sending the pack. Quick answers below: 

- Questionnaire: we'd like Redwood to start with SIG-Core. We have an internal CAIQ but prefer SIG-Core to align with our vendor program.
- SOC 2: most recent SOC 2 Type II is March 2025; we can provide the full report and a bridge letter. I'll route through our security mailbox (security@finops.co).
- HIPAA: scope is limited — only billing metadata that references protected health identifiers for certain customers. We can produce a short scope doc.
- EU residency: we require EU data residency for a small subset of customers (we'll provide a list of account IDs).

I attached our vendor addendum and a short scope note (FinOps-Security-Addendum.docx). Expected turnaround: we typically need vendor responses in 10 business days; if Redwood needs an extended review, let us know.

We don't need an updated MSA to start the security review; legal may circle back later if controls or obligations change.

I'll loop our security lead if we require additional evidence.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Vendor Risk | FinOps Co
alex.johnson@finops.co
Attachment stub: FinOps-Security-Addendum.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finops.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:31:00 -0000
Subject: Re: FinOps SIG kickoff, SOC 2 status & clarifying questions

Great — thanks Alex, that helps a lot. Couple of follow-ups and proposed plan: 

Follow-ups: 
- If you can drop the SOC 2 and bridge letter into security@finops.co that will be perfect. Grace will intake and map evidence to SIG questions.
- For HIPAA scope, could you send the short scope doc you mentioned (one-pager is fine) so we can mark which controls apply?
- For EU account list, a CSV with account IDs is ideal. If that's sensitive, a redacted export is fine.

Proposed plan / timeline: 
- Day 0: FinOps confirms questionnaire choice (SIG-Core) and uploads SOC 2 + scope docs.
- Day 1-3: Redwood prefill SIG answers for admin controls and ingest SOC 2 evidence.
- Day 4-10: Technical evidence collection and follow-ups (API, encryption keys, devops access logs).
- Day 10-14: Finalize responses and deliver completed SIG package for your review.

Grace will be primary owner (grace.oconnor@redwood.ai). Dev will support on enclave/config questions. If this timeline is tight for you, we can compress to a 7-day turnaround but will need your security engineer to be available for quick clarifications.

Proposed kickoff call: Thu Jun 11 10:00 PT works for us — calendar invite to follow.

Best,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finops.co>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: FinOps SIG kickoff, SOC 2 status & clarifying questions

Thanks Alex / Monica — looping in a short technical checklist so we can make the kickoff call productive.

Quick checklist for kickoff (prep items from FinOps):
- SOC 2 report + bridge letter (PDF)
- HIPAA scope one-pager
- CSV of EU account IDs (or redacted list)
- Point-of-contact for technical Qs (email + availability)
- Any vendor-specific CAIQ/assessment that FinOps expects us to populate

We'd like to:
- Confirm the SIG-Core template variant you want (we support v1/v2 templates)
- Ask for a short list of 3 technical contacts (engineer, infra owner, compliance) so we can send targeted questions

Proposed 30-min kickoff: Thu Jun 11 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — I'll send calendar invite with a short agenda (intake, evidence handoff, timeline).

If you prefer a different time, tell us and we'll adapt. Looking forward to working through this quickly.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
Grace.OConnor@redwood.ai
